name: Ash Crimson
original_name: アッシュ・クリムゾン
source:
2nd year high school student. The protagonist's classmate.
He's come back to Japan from France.
A rich boy who does ridiculous things with his money
He has a frivolous personality and you can't really follow what he's thinking.
He tends to make fun of people and doesn't really have anybody you could call a friend at school.
He often does eccentric things like walking on a rose petal carpet to school and eating crab for lunch in the cafeteria.
